kitDescription: Sora is a Wind-element rocket-launcher Supporter whose kit is almost entirely healing-oriented. Her first skill permanently increases her own outgoing healing by 35.2%. Her second skill activates only when she or an ally destroys an enemy part: it stores a portion of her excess healing in up to five stacks and grants the whole team an ATK buff scaled off her own ATK for 15 seconds — against enemies with no destructible parts this skill simply never activates. Her burst heals the entire team for roughly half of her max HP and cleanses one debuff from each ally. On the scope-lock test boss, which has no parts and applies no debuffs, only the burst heal has any gameplay effect, and it matters because teammates whose skills trigger when they receive healing fire off each of her casts.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found: all six kit lines are FAITHFUL (the burst heal — the kit's only live line, modeled burstCast/allies/heal and probed firing 5× on its 40s CD with recovery landings exactly on cast frames) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (heal-out 35.2%, both part-gated skill2 lines plus their trigger header, and the cleanse — each verbatim in unmodeled with estimate/recipe/Tier-2 residuals R1–R3 and a named nearest-wrong the suites discriminate). The blind re-derivations converged strongly: S2b dispositioned all 6 lines identically to the driver, S5's prose-only suite runs 12-pass/2-self-declared-skip GREEN against the shipped override (its skips are exactly the driver's K1/K4), and S6's single divergence — an `unsupported`-trigger skill2 block vs the driver's empty-slot+verbatim-unmodeled — is behaviorally identical (no engine handling; partless boss) and was ruled a blind-side style difference, with the driver form matching repo precedent. Discrimination is real, not vacuous: the RED phase showed 6/12 failing pre-implementation, and every load-bearing assertion reds under its named counterfactual (heal-removed, self-only, fullBurstEnter, materialized-passive-ATK), with the fixture properly isolating the recovery channel (bare folkwang, lifesteal-stripped asuka → sora sole source). Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: every agent here shares the prior that (a) part-gated kits are truly inert vs partless targets in game and (b) heal magnitude never matters to on-recovery consumers — both rest on repo precedent (diesel-winter-sweets/ark-ranger-black/cocoa, engine event model) rather than a fresh measurement of Sora herself; a single parted-fight footage read of Sora's skill2 uptime would independently confirm R1's premise.
